40488914.source: L. reuteri trial (PMID 40488914) abstract: primary endpoint AAD 'at 14 days (7.9% vs. 16.7%; RR: 0.47, 95%CI 0.30-0.7); at 21 days ... RR: 0.49; and at 56 days (9.1% vs. 19.6%; RR: 0.46, 95%CI 0.30-0.69)'. TIMEPOINT CORRECTION (override): the abstract extractor took the 14-day RR 0.47; the study-end (56-day) AAD result is RR 0.46 (0.30-0.69), the timepoint consistent with the other trials' end-of-follow-up AAD.
40488914.verification: 56-day RR 0.46 (0.30-0.69) verbatim in the abstract (9.1% vs 19.6%). Corrects a 14-day-vs-study-end timepoint mismatch (cycle 75 audit).

17356555.reason: declared absent (population mismatch, cross-family definition audit): the stored RR 0.21 is a PER-PROTOCOL analysis of the 63 patients who 'completed the study according to the protocol', not the 87 randomized (46 vs 41).
